The '''Eagle Cluster Bomb''' is an offensive [[Stratagems|stratagem]] that calls in a carpet bomb on the area. 

== Stratagem Statistics ==
{{Stratagem Stats Table
| call_time = 4.1
| uses = 4
| uses_upgraded = 5
| cooldown = 15
| cooldown_upgraded = 8
| rearm_time = 150
| rearm_time_upgraded = 120
}}

== Detailed Weapon Statistics ==
{{Attack Data Stratagem}}
Each cluster bomb explodes into 8 submunitions, for a total of 64 with no upgrades. The cluster bomb airbursts to release its bomblets so the projectile itself won't hit its target.

== Tactical Information ==
* A large amount of small bombs will land in the target zone and kill most small to medium enemies in the area. 
* The Eagle releases the bombs in a straight line, perpendicular to the direction of the stratagem beacon's towards the Helldiver's initial position from where they threw the beacon.
** If the beacon bounces off of an object, the direction will be chosen based off where the beacon finally landed and the initial throwing location
* The cluster bomb can completely devastate a large area. Be careful of your fellow helldivers before throwing this stratagem out.
* Most small and medium enemies in the area will be annihilated by the bombs. Use them against large groups of small and medium targets
* Sometimes, you'll get lucky and one of the bombs will fall into a fabricator vent or bughole, destroying it, but don't count on it.
* Like other explosive stratagems, Eagle Cluster Bomb can destroy optional mission objectives like the [[Terminate Illegal Broadcast|Illegal Broadcast Tower]] and Spore Spewer.

{{Change History Update|1.001.100|changes=
Changes
* Every Stratagem capable of damaging heavily armored enemies has had their damage increased to account for the increased health of heavier enemies.
** Projectile standard damage increased from 500 to 1,500.
** Projectile durable damage increased from 500 to 1,500.
** Direct Penetration increased from {{armor|5|ap}} to {{armor|7|ap}}.
** Slight Angle Penetration increased from {{armor|5|ap}} to {{armor|7|ap}}.
** Large Angle Penetration increased from {{armor|5|ap}} to {{armor|7|ap}}.
